feature_spec_table_md:
| Variant | # scalar feats | scalar dim | + canonical (hidden) | total MLP input dim | rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 0 | 0 | 4096 | 4096 | MIND backbone only (canonical last-token last-layer hidden) — the floor. |
| B | 1 | 1 | 4096 | 4097 | backbone + D_mean (layer drift). |
| C | 1 | 1 | 4096 | 4097 | backbone + V_last (cross-layer variance). |
| D | 1 | 1 | 4096 | 4097 | backbone + H_mean (predictive entropy). |
| E | 3 | 3 | 4096 | 4099 | backbone + full MIND+ scalar trio. |
| F | 1 | 1 | 4096 | 4097 | backbone + single attention feature F1. |
| G | 1 | 1 | 4096 | 4097 | backbone + single logit-lens feature F5. |
| H | 1 | 1 | 4096 | 4097 | backbone + single margin feature F7. |
| I | 3 | 3 | 4096 | 4099 | backbone + best single-feature trio (F1,F5,F7). |
| J | 9 | 9 | 4096 | 4105 | backbone + all 9 F1-F10 features (HalluShift-style stack). |
| K | 6 | 6 | 4096 | 4102 | backbone + MIND+ trio + best F-trio. |
| L | 12 | 12 | 4096 | 4108 | backbone + every MIND+/F1-F10 scalar. |
| M | 10 | 10 | 4096 | 4106 | backbone + URP + layer-trajectory curvature (geometry-focused, NEW). |
| N | 4 | 4 | 4096 | 4100 | backbone + confidence-trajectory + attention-rank + prompt-echo (NEW). |
| O | 12 | 12 | 4096 | 4108 | backbone + URP + LTC + CTS (best-of-new geometry/confidence trio). |
| P | 18 | 18 | 4096 | 4114 | backbone + MIND+ trio + ALL new F11-F16 features (most ambitious). |
